page.layout: One text column, with marginal notes in the left margin. Running head at the top, catchword at the bottom right. Notes sit beside the paragraphs "Adhuc fuerunt flores alterantes" and "Hucusq; de Floribus".

main_text.p: Flatus discutiunt; Anethi, Chamomillæ, Junci odorati, Spicanardi, &c.
Ambustis medentur, Liliorum albo-rum, Malvæ, Verbasci, &c.
Dolorem mitigant: Anethi, Chamomillæ, Centaurii, Hyoscyami, Meliloti, Rosmarini.
Adhuc fuerunt flores alterantes: Sequuntur purgantes, & quidem: Flores purgates,
Bilem, ut flores Persicorum, Ceraforum, Prunorum sylvestrium, Violarum, Rosarum, &c.
Pituitam & Serum, ut Carthami, Geniftæ, Sambuci, &c.
Hucusq; de Floribus, Sequuntur Fructus & Semina. De Fru-ctibus. Fructuum qualitates prima,
Temperati fructus sunt: Ficus, Nux, Pinea, Palmulæ, Sebesten, Uvæ passæ, etc.
Intemperati sunt Calidi, Frigidi, Humidi, vel Sicci.

page.notes: Marginal notes in the left margin are set in italic: "Flores purgates," and "De Fru-ctibus. Fructuum qualitates prima," (final letter partly obscured, read as "prima,").
